description: Shared reference data: geography, currencies, lines of business, statutory reporting lines and external industry code sets.

lob_category.description: Top-level grouping of lines of business.

statement_type.description: NAIC annual statement blank an ASL belongs to.

entities.name: jurisdiction
entities.description: Regulatory jurisdiction: a US state, district or territory, the federal government, or a foreign country. Drives filings, licensing, statutory reporting and claim handling rules.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 style code, e.g. US-CA; US for federal.

attributes.name: naic_state_code
attributes.description: NAIC numeric state code used in statutory reporting.

entities.name: line_of_business
entities.description: Hierarchical line of business as managed by the company (e.g. Personal Auto, Homeowners, Workers' Compensation, Term Life, Group Medical).

entities.name: annual_statement_line
entities.description: NAIC annual statement line of business (e.g. 19.2 Other Private Passenger Auto Liability) used for statutory reporting such as Schedule P and the state page.

entities.name: cause_of_loss
entities.description: Peril or cause of loss (collision, fire, wind, theft, water damage, bodily injury, ...).

attributes.name: peril_group
attributes.description: Roll-up group, e.g. WEATHER, FIRE, LIABILITY, THEFT.

entities.name: code_set
entities.description: An externally published code system and version, e.g. ICD-10-CM 2026, CPT, HCPCS, NDC, NAICS 2022, NCCI class codes, ISO GL class codes, WCIO injury codes, CARC, NUCC taxonomy.

attributes.name: code_set_code
attributes.description: Short identifier such as ICD10CM, CPT, NAICS, NCCI_CLASS.

entities.name: code_value
entities.description: A single code within a code set.
